songs.subject: Krishna mantra bhajan: the chorus may use a public-domain mantra ("हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे, हरे राम हरे राम राम राम हरे हरे" or "ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय"; name it in public_domain_text); the verses are your own

Mahadev 'attitude' anthem: the swag and power of Bholenath (tandav, damru, Kailash, Neelkanth), bold and proud, a chant-like chorus with महादेव / भोलेनाथ; dhol and a modern devotional beat. ORIGINAL words only, no intoxication references (no bhang/chillum), no trending song's hook or melody.

Maa Parvati / Shakti roop anthem (coordinator, 15 Nov 2026: the trending fierce-Parvati genre): powerful and proud, Maa Gauri as Shakti on Kailash with trishul, the whole world bowing, dhol and a modern devotional beat; name her as पार्वती / गौरी / भवानी (spoken clearly, not right after श्री) at least once in the chorus. ORIGINAL words only: never the line 'जब ज़िद पे आ गई पार्वती' or any trending song's hook, title or melody. Devotional, never violent or gory.
